title: Existing unbounded compact-support composition
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}T$ morphisms of arbitrary schemes. Suppose that $f$, $g$ and $fg$ admit compactifications [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For compact support on the ordinary unbounded etale module derived categories [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], there is a natural isomorphism $R(gf)_!\cong Rg_!Rf_!$. No quasi-compactness or Noetherianity is assumed beyond the supplied compactifications.

source.place: nonempty_iso_rightDerivedLowerShriek_comp; existing proved source theorem, graph-factorization proof

proof.text: Use the already proved source theorem nonempty_iso_rightDerivedLowerShriek_comp. Its construction embeds the source by a proper map into an open of the product of compactification ambients. The same graph computes f and its composite. Torsion proper base change exchanges open extension with the proper projection; compose the two open extensions and the proper derived pushforwards. The graph model comparisons identify this composite with the chosen compactifications. This does not take a quasi-compact closure and therefore needs no quasi-compactness of f, g or their composite.
